vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-111181
vulnerability.description: body-parser: Denial of Service via unhandled decompression stream error

statements.impact_statement: body-parser is a transitive dep via express@^5.1.0 (which depends on body-parser@^2.2.1). Lifted it past the fix by adding `body-parser: ^2.4.0` to backend/package.json overrides; backend/package-lock.json now resolves body-parser@2.4.0. Backend unit tests (680) pass; lint, backend typecheck, and build all green.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-110180
vulnerability.description: fast-uri: Security policy bypass via improper host canonicalization

statements.impact_statement: fast-uri is a devOptional transitive via ajv@^8.20.0 (`fast-uri: ^3.0.1`). Existing override was `^3.1.7`; bumped to `^3.1.9` in backend/package.json so the lockfile now resolves fast-uri@3.1.9. Verified via lint, backend unit tests (680 passing), backend typecheck, and build.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-110306
vulnerability.description: fast-uri: Cross-Site Scripting via improper URI scheme decoding

statements.impact_statement: Same bump as CVE-2026-110180: fast-uri override lifted from `^3.1.7` to `^3.1.9` in backend/package.json; lockfile resolves fast-uri@3.1.9. Verified via lint, backend unit tests, typecheck, and build.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-113872
vulnerability.description: multer: Denial of Service via aborted request during asynchronous file filtering

statements.impact_statement: multer is a direct backend runtime dep (used for multipart upload parsing). Bumped from `^2.4.0` to `^2.5.0` in backend/package.json; lockfile resolves multer@2.5.0. Backend unit tests (680) all pass, including upload-handling suites; lint, typecheck, and build green.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-85x2-q946-cp5h
vulnerability.description: nodemailer: '>' inside a quoted local part ends an angle-addr early in addressparser, delivering to a domain the header does not name

statements.impact_statement: nodemailer is a direct backend runtime dep. Bumped from `^10.0.2` to `^10.1.4` in backend/package.json; lockfile now resolves nodemailer@10.2.1 (satisfies the fix at 10.1.4). Backend unit tests (680) pass; lint, typecheck, and build green.
